Name: No Desert Trader Required
Author: cosplaywrite
Description:
Would you rather keep your precious geodes and gems to yourself? If you said yes, this mod is for you!

With this mod, you'll be able to obtain the Desert Trader's exclusive items without every visiting his camel-driven caravan.

This mod adds:

[spoiler]A special order from Sandy.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Hats available from the trader are now sold by Hat Mouse in the Cindersap Forest. Furniture is now available at Robin's.[/spoiler]

Manifest.Name: No Desert Trader Required
Manifest.Description: Makes most of the Desert Trader exclusive items available via other means.
